Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Delayed Sign-In Reorder Flow: Move sign-in step to immediately follow adoption certificate creation so users connect with their pet before creating an account. (why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users early in the funnel. Delaying registration until after pet creation leverages commitment bias.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Visibility Diagnostic Screen: Add an interactive desktop visibility test step where users trigger a quick wave animation to confirm their pet rendered on screen. (why: Finish drops to 64.8% conversion with long completion time, and 3 support tickets complained about pets failing to appear on desktop.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Companion Greeting Flow: Introduce a dedicated interaction screen at the end of onboarding where users practice their first pet greeting command. (why: Support emails showed confusion around controlling or talking to the pet post-onboarding, and finish step conversion is only 64.8%.)
3: [home, notification] Desktop Preparation System Notification: Enable optional OS notifications during background pet rendering so users are alerted as soon as their companion is ready. (why: Home step waiting time has a huge mean of 2336s, indicating users tab away during background generation and forget to return.)
4: [sign_in, copy] Multi-Device Sync Account Guarantee Copy: Update sign-in copy to explicitly highlight data persistence and memory backup across desktop sessions. (why: The top support theme (8 emails) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, creating anxiety around sign-in.)
5: [adoption, layout] Split Photo Upload Verification Layout: Change photo upload screen layout to split view showing real-time lighting and angle requirements alongside photo upload. (why: Custom pet generation fails or produces poor visual results according to 3 support tickets.)
6: [home, wait_info] Live Generation Step Checklist Progress: Display active multi-step rendering progress counters during pet creation waiting room. (why: Home wait step has high mean (2336s) and median (201s) time; step-by-step feedback maintains active user engagement.)
